name: compat-oracle
description: Grades burgee's compatibility against commander and yargs, and roundel's against chalk, using their own test suites, plus reference drivers that run the real incumbents for byte-for-byte comparison. Internal; never published.
//devDependencies: Vendored suites are run unedited, so whatever they require is a dependency of this package — pinned, because the oracle's number has to be the number a stranger gets from `npm ci`.

cli-table (0.3.11) is a *second* incumbent, and it is here as a test dependency of the first: cli-table3's own `verify-legacy-compatibility-test.js` runs its assertions twice, once against `require('cli-table')` and once against our shim, to show the two agree. Without it that file fails to load and the control reads 15 / 16 on a clean install while the PR asserts 33 / 33. The nine cases that grade cli-table itself are excluded by name in hosts.ts; the file still has to load.
@colors/colors (1.5.0) is required directly by four of cli-table3's test files and reached us only as a hoisted optional dependency of cli-table3 — the same fragility, one release from breaking.
